from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    "0": {"processing_time": 36, "due_date": 131, "weight": 10},
    "1": {"processing_time": 78, "due_date": 308, "weight": 1},
    "2": {"processing_time": 84, "due_date": 210, "weight": 6},
    "3": {"processing_time": 3, "due_date": 278, "weight": 9},
    "4": {"processing_time": 31, "due_date": 158, "weight": 2},

    "6": {"processing_time": 47, "due_date": 190, "weight": 8},
    "7": {"processing_time": 18, "due_date": 302, "weight": 6},
    "8": {"processing_time": 85, "due_date": 279, "weight": 8},
    "9": {"processing_time": 42, "due_date": 326, "weight": 6}
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Create variables
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Set objective
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[str(j)]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Add constraints
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assigned_once")

model.addConstrs((C[j] >= jobs[str(i)]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(
    jobs[str(k)]["processing_time"] * x[k, j] for k in range(n) if k != i) for i in range(n) for j in range(n)), name="completion_time")

model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[str(i)]["due_date"] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if x[i, j] == 1), name="tardiness")

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
import json
print(json.dumps({"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}))
